status: UNSIGNED DRAFT: nothing here has been run for the study
procedure: P1: one-sided Student t(G-1) on the CR1 statistic, Holm over the first K hypotheses at alpha_op (reviewer-directed prospective selection, 2026-10-24); NON-GATING power diagnostic

effect.formula: mu = d * sigma_RMS / sqrt(G); sigma_RMS = sqrt(mean_g sigma_g^2); constant across sessions; added after generation to hypothesis planted_index only; d is the noncentrality-scale effect (a0: the t statistic has noncentrality exactly d), not a raw per-session standardised shift

generators.definition: reused unchanged from research/v118/f3_accept/core.py (a0 iid N(0,1) G x 16; b0 z * s_g, s = exp(linspace(0, ln scale_ratio, G)); b1 session distribution cycling normal / t3 / centred lognormal by session index mod 3, times s_g); all null datasets are drawn in chunks of `chunk` from ONE SplitMix64 stream per (regime, G) cell and reused for every d (common random numbers: dataset i is the same null dataset for every d)

disjoint_from: 20291100-20291199 and 20291900-20291999 (acceptance study and its dry run)

interval.note: Wilson 95% two-sided, pointwise, for every power estimate; not simultaneous

mde.rule: first-crossing linear interpolation; '<= first grid value' if already reached at the first grid point; '> last grid value' if never reached; never extrapolated; reported to one decimal; non-monotone curves flagged, first crossing kept, flagged cells excluded from the MDE ratio

bootstrap.note: paired bootstrap over independent dataset replications: one index set per resample used for every d and every K; percentile indices floor(lo_q (B-1)) and ceil(hi_q (B-1)) of the ordered replicates, order '<= first' < numbers < '> last'; also used for adjacent-d power differences

ratio.note: heterogeneous-to-homogeneous power ratio defined only when both counts are >= min_count; delta-method interval on log R from the two independent streams

integrity.rule: for every a0 (G, K, d): pi_ref - tau <= phat <= min(1, pi_ref + excess) + tau, pi_ref = noncentral-t P(T'(G-1, d) >= t_{1-alpha_op/K}(G-1)), excess = 1 - (1 - alpha_op/K)^(K-1); evaluated FIRST, before any power estimate, MDE80 or ratio is computed or shown
integrity.on_failure: run declared VOID (programming integrity): DECISION.json status VOID_INTEGRITY with the offending (G, K, d); no power table, MDE80 or ratio is produced; no estimate from the run may be cited; a corrected package needs the full sign-off route with FRESH seeds
integrity.tau_note: tau is a heuristic tolerance: numerically five times the worst-case binomial standard error (0.005 at n = 10,000); it is NOT a simultaneous confidence guarantee across the grid and the band is a programming-integrity check, not evidence of calibration

excess.comparison: under a0 the K-1 null p-values are exact (Student t on independent normal sessions) and independent of the planted hypothesis; P(at least one null p <= alpha_op/K) is the probability that the first Holm step rejects a null, which is the only way the planted hypothesis can be rejected with its own p above alpha_op/K; so power lies in [pi_ref, pi_ref + excess_K]
excess.why: it is the exact value of that probability at alpha_op = 0.020, evaluated once per K and frozen here; power_math.excess must reproduce these values to 1e-12 (checked by check_freeze and a test)

stop_rules.crash_policy: an interrupted run may be resumed exactly as declared in `resume`; nothing else is permitted
stop_rules.final_policy: a completed run (including VOID_INTEGRITY) is final under this prereg: no rerun, no new seeds, no changed grid, n, generators or definitions

non_gating: this study has no pass/fail criterion and no power floor; its results cannot change the completed F3 acceptance result or any Type I criterion, set alpha_op, choose a procedure, close F3 or support any real-data, power-in-practice, alpha or trading claim
data_versions_sentinel: synthetic-no-data: a declared sentinel only. NO market data are consumed (no data/real access, no holdout registry, no dataset reader); it is not a dataset identifier and not a holdout exemption

stream.rule: each (regime, G) cell creates ONE SplitMix64 stream from its seed and consumes it chunk after chunk; chunking never resets or reseeds the generator; chunk size, ordering of draws and the generator implementation are part of the frozen identity
stream.evidence: the cell record stores rng_final_state, chunk_counts_sha256 and indicators_sha256

resume.permitted: an interrupted run may be resumed at cell granularity only; every finished cell file is re-verified by recomputing the cell under the CURRENT verified signed identity and comparing identity_sha256, prereg_sha256, seed, chunk, n, rng_final_state, chunk_counts_sha256, indicators_sha256 and the counts; any difference refuses the run
resume.failed_study: a run holding a DECISION.json is refused (one run only)
